ruleDefinitions.name: LOLBIN Execution From Abnormal Drive
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects LOLBINs executing from an abnormal or uncommon drive such as a mounted ISO.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\calc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmstp\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\installutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "CALC\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "CertUtil\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "CMSTP\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "cscript\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "installutil\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "MSHTA\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "REGSVR32\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "wscript\.exe")) AND  NOT (process_working_directory = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\.*") OR process_working_directory = "" OR process_working_directory = "None")
